mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a cool 67 degrees with overcast skies near the Verona Public Library, with a Waning Gibbous moon phase tonight. The overnight low will drop to 65 degrees, and rain is predicted as we head into tomorrow.

The City of Verona Water Utility is launching cross connection control surveys to keep our water supply clean and safe. Additionally, remember to visit City Hall to cast your absentee ballot for the upcoming election, with early voting available until the Friday before election day.

Today, you can head to Hometown Junction Park for the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, enjoy a class at Insight Wellness, or stop by Wisconsin Brewing Company for their Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher event. Looking ahead, you can check out the Art Bar Happy Hour tomorrow at ART House 360.

In our weekly look back, police were called to the 400 block of East Verona Avenue on September 21. Officers identified and cited an individual for retail theft involving the theft of Swedish Fish candy.
It is a great day to grab a scoop of the Double Strawberry flavor of the day at Culver's. They are currently open until 10 PM, so make sure to stop by before they close for the night.
